candidates.name: Dynamic Malware Behavior Dataset (DMBD)
candidates.provenance: LLNL Wintap host logs from ~5-minute cyber-range executions. Overview page reports 65,416 samples and ~39 million events.
candidates.license_or_terms: Unverified in this checkout; operators must review LLNL terms.
candidates.formats_documented: Wintap/DMBD event and label tables (not present here)
candidates.process_identity_documented: pid_hash (hostname + os pid + start_time); os_pid is not unique
candidates.ground_truth_quality: Sample labels are AV consensus, not analyst event labels. They must not be copied onto every process event.

suitability.RQ1_reconstruction: promising if process tables are supplied; unverified locally
suitability.RQ2_detection: sample-level only unless extra labels appear
suitability.RQ3_hybrid: Phase 9 hybrid not comparable (Linux identity model)
suitability.RQ5_robustness: possible on adapters; not a substitute for missing corpus
suitability.RQ6_cannot_validate: Ed25519 enrollment, Linux boot_id/start_ticks, live agent identity, event-level malice

candidates.rank_reason: Preferred adapter target: documented stable pid_hash, parent links, lifecycle timestamps, and an official train/test split. Rank is not an evaluation result.

candidates.name: WinMET Windows malware execution traces
candidates.provenance: CAPE sandbox traces processed by MALVADA; ~31,844 JSON traces.
candidates.license_or_terms: Zenodo record; 7z password documented as infected. Review before use.
candidates.process_identity_documented: in-trace process_id / parent_id; not a host-global GUID
candidates.lifecycle_documented: sandbox execution window; termination not independently verified here
candidates.label_granularity: trace/sample malware-family labels (CAPE and AVClass); malware-only corpus
candidates.ground_truth_quality: Family labels on sandbox traces. No benign class in the described corpus.
candidates.official_split_documented: not documented as an official train/test partition in this audit
candidates.os: Windows sandbox, not continuous enterprise telemetry

suitability.RQ1_reconstruction: process trees documented; files absent locally
suitability.RQ2_detection: family classification possible; binary malice lacks benign traces
suitability.RQ5_robustness: sandbox artefacts differ from live endpoints
suitability.RQ6_cannot_validate: benign class, Linux identity, live enrollment

candidates.rank_reason: Strong process-tree JSON, but malware-only and ~750 GiB unpacked.

candidates.name: DARPA OpTC
candidates.provenance: DARPA Transparent Computing scale-out; Windows 10 eCar + Zeek.
candidates.license_or_terms: Unverified here; distribution via documented GDrive.
candidates.process_identity_documented: actorID/objectID UUIDs plus pid/ppid; pid is not unique
candidates.parent_child_documented: ppid present; UUID actorID is the stronger handle
candidates.lifecycle_documented: PROCESS START/TERMINATE actions in eCar (documented examples)
candidates.network_association_documented: FLOW object with pid; joining quality unverified locally
candidates.label_granularity: Folder-implied activity plus separate later labeling projects that do not fully agree
candidates.ground_truth_quality: Known disagreement between host-labeling efforts; not inspected locally.
candidates.official_split_documented: benign then evaluation periods; not a sample-level ML split
candidates.os: Windows 10 enterprise testbed (500 hosts in the released data)

suitability.RQ1_reconstruction: possible in principle; 1 TB and no local files
suitability.RQ6_cannot_validate: Linux agent identity; agreed event-level labels without extra corpora

candidates.rank_reason: Closest to enterprise Windows telemetry, impractical without an operator copy.
